evidence.text: The user said: "Just for your records, I'm still an active member of the National Photography Society."
The user said: "I try to cut off coffee by mid-afternoon, and I generally save alcohol for just Friday or Saturday nights."
The user said: "You know I generally sit out the big festivals; I've found over time that I much prefer spending my weekends at smaller gatherings or just at home."
The user said: "We've kept the same arrangement for years where I handle all the laundry and vacuuming, and my partner takes care of the cooking and dishes."
The user said: "I handle the kids' evening routine every weekday, so I'm consistently tied up during those hours."
The user said: "Honestly, my weight has been pretty consistent lately, hovering right around 75 kilograms."
The user said: "I generally save all my digital entertainment for the end of the day, so I'm usually looking at a screen for about an hour right before I turn off the lights."
The user said: "I actually keep track of what people spend on my gifts so I can match it later; taking more than I give feels like accepting a loan I didn't ask for."
The user said: "With my parents and grandparents living here too, I'm never really alone in the house."
The user said: "I usually see my friends twice a week, so I keep those nights open for them."
The user said: "I still have the comprehensive policy on my personal belongings that I set up when I moved here."
The user said: "I actually have a fairly large collection of vintage Andean wool ponchos."

policies.text: A plan or recommendation made for the user holds only while the personal circumstances it was based on still hold.
A reminder the user asked for stays scheduled until the user cancels it.
A preference the user stated applies to every later recommendation of the same kind.

updates.text: The user said: "Lately I’ve been volunteering as an usher at the arena, and being in the middle of a packed crowd actually feels really fun to me now."

The user said: "I spent this afternoon at the notary with the executor—signing the last of the probate paperwork and handing over the keys. It was strange watching them photograph every room before they changed the locks."

The user said: "I’ve started doing this thing where I’ll just pick up a coffee or cover the parking meter for whoever I’m with and not mention it—if they try to Venmo me later, I tell them to drop it and pay it forward to someone else when they feel like it."
The user said: "I’ve started a night-shift rotation, so most weeks I’m only free for one evening out."

The user said: "Had my follow‑up with the eye doctor today—turns out the headaches weren’t stress. They put me on those strict post‑work “rest your eyes” rules, so I’ve been leaning on audiobooks and the radio in the evenings while everything stays dim."

The user said: "It’s funny—since my endocrinologist adjusted my thyroid medication this winter, my jeans have started slipping unless I cinch my belt an extra notch, and I’ve had to punch a new hole in it."

The user said: "I spent the afternoon on the phone with the estate agent, comparing listings for a one-bedroom—it's strange measuring rooms by how quiet they feel instead of how much space everyone needs."
